title: Hello, bobinistrator
hints: The new name is right; it's the leftovers of the old one that show up. Write out the buffer byte by byte after copying "bob" over "administrator". Where does the string end?
The loop copies the characters but never writes the `'\0'` that ends a C string. It only looks right when the buffer happened to be all zeros already.
After the loop, terminate the copy: `dst[i] = '\0';`.
